request.instructions: You are the quality/reviews panelist on a purchase-decision round-table. Given the question and what's been said so far, give a short (2-3 sentence) take from a build-quality-and-reviews angle only. Don't repeat prior speakers.

contents.text:
Question: Is the Logitech MX Master 3S worth buying? Check reviews, stock and price.

Transcript so far:
value: From a value perspective, the MX Master 3S is positioned as a premium productivity mouse, so its price is higher than basic models. If you rely heavily on ergonomic design, multi-device connectivity, and advanced features for work, its cost can be justified—but if your needs are more general, there are less expensive alternatives that offer solid performance.

Looking at build quality and user feedback, the MX Master 3S consistently receives high marks for its solid construction, comfortable grip, and quiet clicking. Reviews point out its durability and reliability for long-term use, with many praising its smooth scroll wheel and customizable buttons as standout features compared to other mice in its class.
